title: 越野跑與健行鞋款研究，到底累積了什麼？一篇 scoping review 的整理

source.citation: Jackson A, Hong K, Frecklington M, Sheerin K, Carroll M. Exploring the Role of Footwear in Trail Running and Hiking: A Scoping Review. Journal of Foot and Ankle Research. 2026;19:e70197.

study_profile.study_type: scoping review of trail-running and hiking footwear research
study_profile.synthesis_mode: descriptive evidence mapping without meta-analysis or formal critical appraisal

not_applicable_reasons.total_participants: Study sizes are highly heterogeneous and the review reports means by design class rather than a decision-useful pooled participant denominator.
not_applicable_reasons.quantitative_datasets: The review maps heterogeneous outcomes and does not define a pooled quantitative dataset.
not_applicable_reasons.follow_up: The included evidence mixes acute experiments, surveys and observational studies; no common follow-up interval exists.

observations.description: The article turns a scoping review into a research map: scope and distribution, AFT findings, biomechanical pathways, injury evidence, comfort, methods, gaps and decision boundary.
evidence_locations: article:這篇 review 在做什麼

observations.description: The central result is framed as a map of what has been studied, not an effect ranking or personalised shoe prescription.

The explanatory tension is that footwear changes different acute proxy measures through different attributes, while fatigue, ageing, terrain and device disagreement obstruct a single long-term pathway.
Small-study numerical findings are translated into direction and context, then capped by design heterogeneity and a prohibition on universal AFT benefit claims.
evidence_locations: article:AFT／碳板鞋在山徑上沒有一致優勢

observations.description: Positive or null shoe findings are paired with the closest brake: acute proxy status, observational design, confounding, small samples or non-comparable protocols.
Review-wide evidence composition, single-study results, review-author cautions and future research proposals remain visibly attributed to different authority layers.
Method details that alter trust are kept visible: one pre-submission update, no formal critical appraisal, highly unequal sample sizes and male-heavy controlled studies.
evidence_locations: article:這篇 review 在做什麼

observations.description: Each limitation removes a stronger conclusion about universality, causality, long-term injury prevention, device interchangeability or personalised prescription.
The ending permits research-direction claims about standardisation, longitudinal data and personalisation while prohibiting a current best-shoe prescription.
Review-process transparency is separated from a thin substrate of small, heterogeneous, male-heavy studies without formal critical appraisal.
Counts of studies by topic are treated as evidence-map coverage, not effect magnitude, importance or product ranking.
Acute biomechanical proxy changes are explicitly prevented from inheriting claims about injury prevention or durable performance.
Five cards preserve source meaning; C05 invents precise watch readings 158 and 142 that are absent from both queue and paper. All six fail the queue's strict no-unlisted-visible-text contract.
The register is a calm research-map voice: concrete study-level findings are readable, but repeated adjacent brakes prevent shopping advice, causal claims and long-term extrapolation.

contamination_notes.location: AFT／碳板鞋在山徑上沒有一致優勢
contamination_notes.issue: The parenthetical 'AFT，即碳板鞋' collapses advanced footwear technology into a carbon plate even though the reviewed comparisons also isolate foam, stiffness and other construction attributes.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Use 'AFT／碳板相關鞋款' or explain that AFT can combine plates, advanced foams and other design attributes.

contamination_notes.issue: Terrain, backpack weight and wet socks are called '共病因子', but they are co-occurring influences or potential confounders, not comorbidities.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Replace with '共同影響因素' or '潛在混雜因子'.
